Nora (AE): FYI EnterpriseY sent back the SQ and wants an air-gapped 30d POC. Requirements: no outbound, HSM-only keys, signed artifacts, and a firm patch cadence window. Need quick SKU for pricing.
Omar (Solutions): Understood. Do they mandate single immutable bundles or allow signed delta patches via a jumpbox?
Nora (AE): They prefer immutable but will accept deltas if we provide double-signing and a chain-of-custody manifest. Also want a rollback guarantee.
Diego (Infra Eng): We support: 1) full signed ISO (sneakernet), 2) chunked USB bundles with resume+verify, 3) jumpbox sync during maintenance window. All include SHA256 sigs. We include rollback manifest in every bundle.
Leah (Security): Telemetry must be off by default. Provide a telemetry-off build and signed SBOM. HSM: require PKCS#11 + offline import CLI and audit trail. Also need an offline cert rotation flow.
Omar (Solutions): SOW items to call out: max USB single-file 16GB (recommend chunking past that), supported OS list (RHEL 8.6, Ubuntu 22.04), preflight script, and CA rotation CLI.
Diego (Infra Eng): Preflight will check kernel, GPU driver, kernel modules, and free disk. If apply fails agent auto-reverts. We require customers to retain previous bundle for 14 days for rollback.
Leah (Security): SQ snippets: Q17 — telemetry disabled by default, config sample: ```telemetry:
  enabled: false
  endpoint: ""``` Q21 — KMS: PKCS#11 supported, offline sealing documented. Q42 — logs stored locally unless operator exports them.
Nora (AE): Pricing ask: give two options — pilot-standard (30d, quarterly features, base fee) and pilot-accelerated (30d, monthly security patches with delta support +20%). Include optional 2-day on-site cutover support.
Omar (Solutions): I’ll draft SOW + runbook. Diego attach chunker docs and preflight script to the ticket. Leah to draft SQ answers.
deploy-bot: Ticket created #PILOT-9007 owner Omar.
Diego (Infra Eng): Heads-up: older RHEL kernels need a specific driver; will add compatibility matrix to runbook.
Nora (AE): Thanks team — aim to send pricing + SOW in 48h. Update #PILOT-9007 if blockers.
